# watchpoint_status_page_component_group (Resource)

A collapsible group of components on a status page. Its status is the worst of its components and its uptime bars merge theirs. Put a component in it with `group_id` on `watchpoint_status_page_component`. Deleting a group leaves its components on the page, ungrouped.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_status_page_component_group" "apis" {
  status_page_id       = watchpoint_status_page.public.id
  name                 = "APIs"
  description          = "Public REST and GraphQL endpoints"
  collapsed_by_default = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Heading shown to visitors.
- `status_page_id` (String) Status page the group belongs to. Changing it replaces the group.

### Optional

- `collapsed_by_default` (Boolean) Render the group folded until the visitor opens it. Defaults to `false`.
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `position` (Number) Sort order among the page's groups and ungrouped components. Defaults to the end of the list.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Group ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_status_page_component_group.apis <status_page_id>/<group_id>
```
